description: This source file defines a ShellExecutor utility for executing shell commands asynchronously with detailed result handling, including timeout management and process control.

classes.name: ShellExecutor
classes.description: A utility singleton providing methods to run shell commands asynchronously, returning detailed results and handling timeouts.

methods.name: runDetailed
methods.description: Executes a command with optional current working directory, environment variables, and timeout; returns detailed execution results as ShellResult.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Wraps runDetailed to execute a command and provides a simplified Response object with success status, message, and payload.
